items.name: Hoshi2Star
items.description: Desktop CAT editor and LLM orchestrator for translating Japanese RPG Maker MV/MZ and Wolf RPG games. Includes glossary, cross-project translation memory, placeholder/line-width QA, and export back into game files; supports local Ollama and optional cloud inference.
items.source_evidence: Maintainer README documents Japanese RPG Maker MV/MZ support, partial Wolf RPG support, CAT workflow and game-file export. The app shows Japanese originals and English examples but supports configurable target languages, not a fixed pair. Latest public release is v0.4.10 (2026-07-07), with Linux AppImage/deb/rpm and Windows MSI/EXE assets: https://github.com/KATBlackCoder/Hoshi2Star/releases/tag/v0.4.10. Repository is not archived and latest commit checked 2026-10-16: https://github.com/KATBlackCoder/Hoshi2Star/commit/de76e64f232b1a15cbbba2f8947926f028211bb8. README version badge is stale at 0.4.3; release page is version authority. GitHub Languages API bytes: Rust 1,883,362; Python 724,352; TypeScript 557,310; HTML 533,300; CSS 9,425; JavaScript 1,194. Rust is largest.

items.name: Game Translate
items.description: Windows game-localization converter that takes existing Simplified Chinese text in compatible Unreal Engine localization assets and produces a reversible external Traditional Chinese patch. It does not translate from English or Japanese; Unity patching is not implemented.
items.source_evidence: Maintainer README says Game Translate converts existing Simplified Chinese text to Traditional Chinese for compatible Unreal Engine games via an external .locres patch and zhconvert.org; it is not an automatic source-language translator. README explicitly says only source code is public and there is no downloadable Windows executable yet; per-game/package support still needs runtime confirmation: https://github.com/DogSay/game-translate/blob/main/README.md. Repository is not archived; its latest commit checked 2026-10-16 is dated 2026-10-05: https://github.com/DogSay/game-translate/commit/34be11837d8e5ced9da7817dfe1dec2142a55ea3. Exact GitHub Languages API bytes: C# 254,612 and JavaScript 134,124 (C# predominant). This human-language utility is distinct from Proton-like OS/graphics/API translation.

items.name: Pokémon Unbound Multi-language ROM Translation Toolkit
items.description: Python-led, game-specific extraction/build workflow and patch repository for Pokémon Unbound language editions. README describes French as the complete reference translation and a multi-language pipeline for Italian, German, and experimental targets; releases package BPS outputs with a manifest and SHA256 checksums.
items.source_evidence: Maintainer README calls the repository an open-source Pokémon Unbound ROM translation toolkit and documents English base-ROM patching, French BPS workflow, and language-specific build/graphics workflows. Release v2.1.179 (2026-10-13) contains French, Italian, German, and experimental Indie BPS assets, a release manifest, and SHA256 sums: https://github.com/AntonyKervazoCanut/gba_translator/releases/tag/v2.1.179. Exact GitHub Languages API map shows Python 4,257,349 bytes is predominant. Tooling is listed separately from the French patch project row.
